claims: J.J. Spaun won the 2026 Valero Texas Open.
J.J. Spaun earned $1,764,000 at the 2026 Valero Texas Open.
The 2026 Valero Texas Open had a total purse of $9.8 million.
The victory was J.J. Spaun's second at the Valero Texas Open.
J.J. Spaun finished 17-under-par at the 2026 Valero Texas Open.
J.J. Spaun defeated runners-up Matt Wallace, Michael Kim, and Robert MacIntyre by one stroke at the 2026 Valero Texas Open.
Matt Wallace, Michael Kim, Robert MacIntyre tied for 2nd at the 2026 Valero Texas Open and earned $741,533.31 each.
Andrew Putnam, Ludvig Åberg tied for 5th at the 2026 Valero Texas Open and earned $378,525 each.
Kevin Yu finished 7th at the 2026 Valero Texas Open and earned $330,750.
Chandler Phillips, Ryo Hisatsune tied for 8th at the 2026 Valero Texas Open and earned $296,450 each.
Tommy Fleetwood, Austin Eckroat, Kristoffer Reitan, Si Woo Kim tied for 10th at the 2026 Valero Texas Open and earned $237,650 each.
The 2026 Valero Texas Open was held at TPC San Antonio (Oaks Course).
J.J. Spaun's final score at the 2026 Valero Texas Open was -17.
The 2026 Valero Texas Open was the final PGA Tour event before the Masters.
Tied-14th place at the 2026 Valero Texas Open earned $159,250.
